description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing and toggling application themes ('light' and 'dark'). It manages theme state, persists theme preference to localStorage, and applies theme styles to the DOM.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: Provides theme context to child components, manages theme state, loads saved preference from localStorage, and applies theme styles to the DOM.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: Custom hook to access theme context; throws error if used outside ThemeProvider.
